verdict.note: Playwright opened #/spec/plugin-system; both panels rendered with 2 backlinks and 2 scenario states, and row clicks reached #/spec/extract and #/evals/rename/live-terminal-renames-own-session.

real Chromium on #/spec/status-bar: the context switch's rendered SVG carries the panel-right path (M11.6 2.5h3.3…) and NOT the list-checks path (m3 7 2 2 4-4), with aria-pressed present and reading false while the dock is closed. Same glyph after opening; state is carried by aria-pressed and the .on tint, never by swapping to a glyph that draws a panel on the left.

Re-measured because this commit changed ContextDock.jsx — the panel now publishes its arrival and folds on the shared mechanism. Playwright on #/spec/issues-view, a node chosen from /api/issues because it actually carries BOTH projections (14 declared scenarios and 15 open issues); a node with only one would not have tested the claim. Settled screenshot shows exactly two sections, Scenarios and Issues, and no backlinks heading anywhere in the dock. 29 rows rendered after both disclosures settled. Clicking a scenario row went to #/evals/issues-view/lifecycle-actions-parity; clicking an issue row went to #/issues/node-popup-eval-filter-dismisses-pane-on-typing. Both panels fetch, so the read waits out their 'loading …' state — reading early reports zero rows and would have scored this a false fail.

Re-measured on the same run, reading each switch's rendered SVG path data out of the live DOM rather than trusting the icon name in source. On #/spec/issues-view with the right dock CLOSED: context switch draws panel-right (the M11.6 2.5h3.3 fill on the right edge), aria-pressed=false. With it OPEN: still panel-right, aria-pressed=true. So the glyph names the dock the control owns and never reports that dock's state, and it draws list-checks in neither state — state is carried by aria-pressed and the active tint, exactly as expected. The rail's own dock switch reads panel-left alongside it, so the mirrored pair stays distinguishable without either impersonating the other. This commit gave the context dock its data-fold arrival, which changes how the panel ARRIVES but not what either switch draws; the reading confirms the vocabulary survived that.
